column1: # What a validator controller's post-quantum root signs. Fixed inputs, chosen so
# every field is distinguishable in the output, and a field swapped for another of
# the same width still changes these bytes.
# controller-auth: TAG u32 | global_id i32 | controller_id u256 | epoch u64 |
#                  nonce u64 | valid_until u32 | kind u8 | payload_hash u256
# The context these are signed under is pinned as `context`, and the key and
# signature rows hold one real ML-DSA-44 signature over `controller-auth`, so a
# consumer can be held to verifying it rather than only to rebuilding bytes.
